steps.en: OCMS gathers the existing hirer or driver details for the alert
steps.id: OCMS mengumpulkan data hirer atau driver yang sudah ada untuk alert
steps.why_en: Only staff manual furnish builds this data; PLUS has to pull the details itself.
steps.why_id: Hanya furnish manual staff yang menyusun data ini; PLUS harus menarik sendiri.

steps.en: OCMS sends an alert with the existing details to PLUS
steps.id: OCMS mengirim alert berisi data lama ke PLUS
steps.why_en: OCMS only answers when PLUS calls; it never sends an alert to PLUS.
steps.why_id: OCMS hanya menjawab saat PLUS memanggil; tidak pernah mengirim alert ke PLUS.

steps.en: The PLUS user is asked to confirm before existing details are overwritten
steps.id: User PLUS diminta konfirmasi sebelum data lama ditimpa
steps.why_en: OCMS has no confirmation field on the PLUS request; the PLUS screen is outside the repo.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak punya field konfirmasi di permintaan PLUS; layar PLUS ada di luar repo.
